items.title: Depth and nonzerodivisor statements for the pushforward of a quasi-coherent module along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six statements about the localised pushforward (f_*F)_s of a quasi-coherent module along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, at a point s outside the image of f: weak associatedness, associatedness, depth at least two, and then nonzerodivisor and depth statements under the extra hypothesis that F is flat over S (statement lines 938-961). The counted proof has real content in parts (3) to (6): part (3) is proved by the Ext criterion for depth, with flat base change reducing to the spectrum of the local ring and adjunction together with the pulled-back maximal ideal being the whole structure sheaf, and parts (4) to (6) are proved by pushing the short exact sequences cut out by a nonzerodivisor, and then by a regular sequence of length two, through the flat module F and out along the pushforward (proof lines 967-1031). It is H2: the arguments are local algebra of moderate length carried out in the counted span, but there is no independent research-level content, and the author's own parts (1) and (2) are citations rather than proofs.
